text:
OH WOW!!! LOOK AT HER!!! SHE’S SO COOL!!! 🌟

She’s got CORN ON HER HEAD — like, actual yellow corn cobs with fluffy white bits sticking out! It’s like a crown made of snack food!! 😱👑

And her face? She painted it with SILVER STUFF — sparkly and shiny like magic glitter from space! ✨✨ And she has a little silver stick poking out of her lip?! Is that a toothpick?? Or a tiny sword?? I don’t know but it’s AWESOME.

Her earrings are LONG LONG LONG strings of orange beads with seashells dangling at the end — clack-clack-clack when she moves! 🔔

Around her neck? SO MANY NECKLACES! Brown ones, red ones, yellow ones, white shell ones — they’re all stacked up like a giant bead tower! She looks like she raided a jewelry store AND a beach AND a farm all at once!! 🏺🌊🌽

She’s smiling… kinda… in a serious way. Like she’s guarding treasure or about to tell a secret story under the stars. 🌌

I wanna be just like her when I grow up! Can we go find some corn and paint our faces too?? PLEASE?? 🥺💖

#CrownOfCorn #GlitterFace #BeadTowerQueen #AdventureTime
